title: Elastic benchmark solver contracts
objective: Create internal TL/UL hyperelastic solver contracts for cantilever benchmark enablement.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E2 elastic benchmark solver scope and non-goals.

scope: Add internal elastic benchmark solver interfaces for TL and UL.
Support SVK and Neo-Hookean material dispatch through existing model behavior.
Keep the public cantilever runner out of this phase.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact before editing any existing elastic solver/helper symbols.
Implement TL and UL small-displacement solve paths on cheap Hex8 meshes.
Run targeted tests and static checks.
acceptance_criteria: TL and UL Hex8 agree in the small-displacement limit.
No public cantilever runner is exposed yet.
No frontend or codegen APIs are changed.
risks: Solver helper contracts may duplicate existing benchmark internals; mitigate by keeping the API internal and moving shared behavior only when duplication is concrete.
completion_notes: Added internal benchmark-local elastic solver contracts in _elastic_solver.py.
TL and UL Hex8 SVK agree in the small-displacement limit.
No public cantilever runner, frontend API, codegen API, or BenchmarkResult change was introduced.
